First is that you replace with the most frequent value.

And second is that you create a new category by the name of missing. Apart from this, there are some other ways like filling with random values. But all these techniques are applicable on numerical data too. That's why I will cover them in a different video. So let's start with the first one. Most frequent missing imputation.

So, if you remember in numerical data, if you had data that was missing completely at random and only 5% or less values were missing, then you were suggested to do mean or median imputation. Basically, all missing values should be replaced with mean or median. In categorical data,

You cannot have mean or median. That's why you replace it with mode. Mode means the data which is most frequently in your variable. Like if you are talking about a column called city.
